nanguan.note: Opens with the recordings that made nanguan known abroad: Tsai Hsiao-yueh singing with Tainan's Nansheng She for Ocora (1983-93), the club's own instrumental pu such as Meihua cao, Wang Xinxin's sung suites, and Li Baiyan, a Quanzhou national inheritor, from a mainland Fujian nanyin anthology. The rest are more Ocora qu, Wang Xinxin's zhi and Buddhist pieces (2000-15), two more Quanzhou singers and the Qinghe Nanguan ensemble's zhi suites and qu (2015-18). All are traditional pieces, so no year written is given; years are release years.
